components.name: Submit button
components.description: Default Luma primary action; Generic Form makes it full width.
components.css: .ds-submit{font-family:ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif,"Apple Color Emoji","Segoe UI Emoji","Segoe UI Symbol","Noto Color Emoji";display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:100%;height:2.25rem;padding:0 .75rem;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:calc(var(--radius)*2.6);background:var(--primary);color:var(--primary-foreground);font-size:.875rem;font-weight:500;line-height:1.25rem;transition:all .15s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);outline:none}.ds-submit:hover{background:color-mix(in oklch,var(--primary) 80%,transparent)}.ds-submit:active{transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-submit:focus-visible{border-color:var(--ring);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch,var(--ring) 30%,transparent)}.ds-submit[aria-invalid="true"]{border-color:var(--destructive);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch,var(--destructive) 20%,transparent)}:host-context(.dark) .ds-submit[aria-invalid="true"]{border-color:color-mix(in oklch,var(--destructive) 50%,transparent);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch,var(--destructive) 40%,transparent)}.ds-submit:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed;pointer-events:none}

narrative.overview:
This document describes the existing `.storybook` and `src/components/revamp` workshop only. The workshop inherits official shadcn Neutral in light and dark modes, fresh Radix Luma presentation dependencies, Lucide icons and system sans-serif typography. Its character is calm, readable and rounded, with semantic color roles and restrained interaction feedback.

The shipped Generic Form preserves authenticated Shadcnblocks composition while connecting typed questions and submission states. This is a record of the workshop source, not a replacement identity for the existing SNMIH production website. Production integration is future work. The finish-review disposition is **ship for the workshop**, with no material fixes and an empty detector result reported by the reviewer; this does not establish browser/CMS/native-admin acceptance or production launch readiness.
keyCharacteristics: Official Neutral light/dark semantics with state-specific error color.
System sans-serif hierarchy and Lucide pictograms inherited from upstream.
Rounded Luma controls and flat form surfaces.
Preserved upstream compositions with caller-owned data and persistence.

rules.name: The Semantic Theme Rule
rules.body: Use the workshop's existing semantic roles and official light/dark values; preserve the production theme boundary.

rules.name: The Upstream Composition Rule
rules.body: Preserve selected source structure and default presentation; typed integration props configure supported content and behavior.

dos: Do use the official workshop semantic roles in both theme modes.
Do preserve authenticated upstream structure, styling and interactions.
Do expose supported content and behavior through typed props and labelled Storybook controls.
Do pair invalid color with field messages, associated descriptions and focus recovery.
Do keep transport and persistence with the caller and demonstration data synthetic.
donts: Don't apply this workshop identity to the existing SNMIH production themes or public site without a separate integration decision.
Don't replace the inherited shared-surface controls with a custom visual alternative.
Don't invent layout or style variants that the selected source and component API do not support.
Don't describe workshop review as completed CMS, native-admin or production acceptance.
